title: 1.1 Meet the People
unit_outcome: Understand and produce simple sentences about people, family members, and actions.
goal: Identify a boy, girl, man, and woman, then use he or she in a short identity sentence.
grammar_function: A + singular person; He/She is a + singular person.
prerequisite: No prior English is required; this is the first course lesson.
speaking_outcome: Say short identity phrases and connect a person noun to he or she.

cards.pedagogy_note: The first person arrives; a introduces one person with boy.
The opening boy remains visible while the noun changes to the pronoun he.
The first two anchors combine into the lesson's first complete sentence.
A second child joins the same meet-the-people sequence.
The opening girl remains visible while the learner connects her to the pronoun she.
The girl follows the same noun-to-pronoun-to-sentence pattern as the boy.
The story now introduces the adult male counterpart to the boy.
The adult male immediately receives the same he-is-a identity frame learned with the boy.
The fourth person completes the cast after the man.
The adult female immediately receives the matching she-is-a identity frame.
The learner first separates child from adult within the male pair.

cards.spanish_translation: Elige la frase para el niño.
cards.pedagogy_note: The boy story immediately grows from the noun to the complete sentence in a new format.
The matching female age contrast follows naturally.

cards.spanish_translation: Elige la frase para la niña.
cards.pedagogy_note: The girl now receives the same noun-to-sentence treatment as the boy.
All four people now appear together as distinct visual categories.
The known he-is-a frame grows from boy to man.

cards.spanish_translation: Elige la frase para el hombre.
cards.pedagogy_note: The man is retrieved from a fresh image before the story moves to the woman.
The four-person contrast returns at the final story character.
The matching she-is-a frame grows from girl to woman.

cards.spanish_translation: Elige la frase para la mujer.
cards.pedagogy_note: Recognition ends on the adult counterpart, ready for audio-only retrieval.
Audio removes the visible target text while preserving the first age contrast.
The complete boy sentence follows the noun while the choice set expands.
The female age contrast immediately mirrors the previous card.
The complete girl sentence mirrors the boy sequence in a four-image format.
The learner now retrieves the complete male identity sentence by ear.
The man is now recognized from audio among complete written sentences.
The complete female identity sentence follows in the same structure.
Listening closes by retrieving the woman sentence in a different response format.
Production begins with the shortest familiar boy phrase.
The boy story grows immediately from noun phrase to full sentence.
The learner expands from a noun phrase to the complete girl sentence.
The same frame transfers from the child to the adult man.

cards.pedagogy_note: Mission beat 01/13: Encuentra los lugares que rodean el punto de encuentro.

audio_assets.text: El encuentro será en el parque. Encuentra el lugar, reconoce el transporte y prepara los objetos con los colores y cantidades que escuches. Al final, lee cuatro respuestas en voz alta para confirmar que todo está listo. Primero escucha la pista completa; después toca el punto de la respuesta.

mission.briefing: El encuentro será en el parque. Encuentra el lugar, reconoce el transporte y prepara los objetos con los colores y cantidades que escuches. Al final, lee cuatro respuestas en voz alta para confirmar que todo está listo. Primero escucha la pista completa; después toca el punto de la respuesta.
objectives: Encuentra el lugar y el transporte
mission.completion_message: Encontraste el lugar, reconociste los objetos, colores y cantidades, y confirmaste cuatro respuestas en voz alta.
mission.voice_instruction: Lee cada respuesta en voz alta para confirmar

chapters.title: Encuentra el lugar
chapters.objective: Reconoce los lugares y el transporte para llegar al encuentro.

chapters.title: Prepara los objetos
chapters.objective: Distingue cada objeto y lo que está cerca o lejos.

chapters.title: Comprueba los detalles
chapters.objective: Escucha colores, números y cantidades para preparar el encuentro.

chapters.title: Todo listo
chapters.objective: Responde cuatro preguntas en voz alta y termina el encuentro.

title: 3.1 Greetings and Names
unit_outcome: Use tightly supported exchanges to greet people and give a name, age, origin and job, ask and answer yes/no questions with be, and describe who owns things.
goal: Recognize and use three greetings plus the fixed name question and answer.
grammar_function: My and your are learned only inside the fixed name chunks; possessive substitution waits for 3.10.
prerequisite: Unit 1 identity questions and Unit 2 text/audio choice routines.
speaking_outcome: Repeat a greeting, ask What is your name?, answer with a name, and close with Goodbye.

title: 3.2 I, You, and We
unit_outcome: Use tightly supported exchanges to greet people and give a name, age, origin and job, ask and answer yes/no questions with be, and describe who owns things.
goal: Connect speaker roles to I, you, and we and use I am, you are and we are with names and known actions.
grammar_function: I am; you are; we are. Speaker perspective is shown explicitly, not inferred from a third-person picture.
prerequisite: 3.1 greeting and name chunks and Unit 1 action sentences with is/are.
speaking_outcome: Say I am Ana., You are Luis. and I am/You are/We are with known actions.

title: 3.3 Am, Is, and Are
unit_outcome: Use tightly supported exchanges to greet people and give a name, age, origin and job, ask and answer yes/no questions with be, and describe who owns things.
goal: Ask what you, she, he and they are doing, and follow each question with an answer using a familiar action.
grammar_function: What are you doing? / I am ...; What is she doing? / She is ...; What is he doing? / He is ...; What are they doing? / They are ... . Complete present-progressive exchanges using familiar Unit 1 actions; do/does is not generalized.
prerequisite: 3.2 I/you/we frames plus Unit 1 he/she/they, is/are, actions, baby and babies.
speaking_outcome: Say all four current-action questions and their matching answers in separate consecutive turns.

title: 3.4 Yes and No
unit_outcome: Use tightly supported exchanges to greet people and give a name, age, origin and job, ask and answer yes/no questions with be, and describe who owns things.
goal: Ask and answer yes/no questions with be about known people and actions: Is he...?, Is she...?, Are you...?
grammar_function: Be before the subject for a yes/no question; short answers Yes, he is. / No, she is not. / Yes, I am.
prerequisite: 1.8 not; 3.2 I/you; 3.3 am/is/are and What are you doing?.
speaking_outcome: Ask Is he...? and Are you...? about known actions and give short yes and no answers.

mission.label: MISIÓN FINAL · UNIDAD 3
mission.title: Cenas cruzadas
mission.briefing: Hoy es la cena internacional del centro comunitario y Ana necesita tu ayuda. Escucha cada frase y descubre quién la dice o a quién describe: saludos, nombres, países, edades, trabajos y cosas de cada invitado. Al final, responde en voz alta en la mesa. Primero escucha la frase completa; después toca a la persona.
mission.completion_message: Reconociste saludos y presentaciones, conociste a cada invitado, descubriste qué hacen y qué tienen, y respondiste en voz alta. La cena internacional puede comenzar.
mission.voice_instruction: Escucha la pregunta y responde en voz alta

cards.pedagogy_note:
From inside the familiar home, the adult moves the same door from closed to open. Use before-and-after action evidence, not a still of a door already open. Do not imply travel to school or work.
Teach the new action open. Only the new word is the Learn English target; complete statements belong to the practice stages. Spanish help uses the appropriate verb or noun meaning.

Continue from that open door: the addressed boy moves it from open to closed, visibly acting on it. Keep door, room and viewpoint consistent; opening and closing must have opposite before/after order.

Show a clearly visible pile of shirts and trousers in the familiar bedroom. Garments are large enough to recognize. Introduce clothes as the new noun, not a basket, laundry appliance or fabric-wiping cloth.

title: 4.10 What Time Is It?
unit_outcome: Say where people and things are at home, describe a short daily routine, ask and answer Do you...? questions, and say the day and the time.

mission.title: Gran misión de familia
mission.briefing: Última misión del nivel A1: acompaña a la familia en la gran celebración y salida al parque. Escucha cada pista y toca el clima, la ropa, cómo se siente cada persona, las actividades y las indicaciones. Al final, responde cuatro veces en voz alta para completar tu certificación A1.
objectives: Verifica el clima y la ropa
Responde cuatro veces en voz alta
